```{r}
set.seed(6301)
n_per_arm <- 25
study <- data.frame(
  id = sprintf("P%03d", 1:(2 * n_per_arm)),
  arm = rep(c("control", "treated"), each = n_per_arm),
  age = round(rnorm(2 * n_per_arm, 55, 11)),
  baseline = rnorm(2 * n_per_arm, 5, 1)
)
study$outcome <- 1 + 0.04 * study$age + 0.5 * study$baseline +
  ifelse(study$arm == "treated", -0.7, 0) + rnorm(nrow(study), 0, 1)
```
